column1: # ProteinGym substitution-fitness re-run for pgym_proteinglm-7b-clm, the last
# cell EXP-R2-240's non-text gap campaign left unrun.
# That cell failed on freeze 20260916101650_39982a07f55e after 30 s with
# `ValueError: ProteinGLM budget prefix+L exceeds seq_length 1024`. The failure
# was in the LENGTH PROBE, not in scoring: stage 20 asks every scorer for
# `token_lengths` before it scores an assay, and records an assay whose maximum
# exceeds that arm's context as a skip with the shared reason "the rendered
# variant exceeds this arm's context; truncating would score a sequence that may
# not contain the mutated position". `_ProteinGLMScorer.token_lengths` rendered
# through `render_budget_sequence`, which refuses an over-context sequence, so
# ProteinGLM could never reach that branch and lost the whole arm instead of the
# assays its 1024 window excludes.
# Fix commit 86bad4e makes the probe total while leaving every scoring-path
# refusal where it was: `proteinglm.budget_token_length` returns
# `PREFIX_LENGTH + L` for any AA20 sequence of two or more residues, and
# `render_budget_sequence` / `encode_budget_text` still raise above the window,
# so an over-context sequence still cannot be scored. The residues 2..L estimand
# is unchanged, and 1021 residues (1024 rendered tokens) is the largest wild type
# this arm scores.
# THIS SUPERSEDES THE EARLIER BLANKET-REFUSAL PLAN. ProteinGLM is no longer
# recorded as an explicit refusal, because the protocol already declares the
# rule it should follow: docs/PROTEINGYM_EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md, "After the
# scorer loads, `token_lengths` is recorded on every drawn variant. An assay is
# excluded only when the maximum rendered length exceeds that checkpoint's
# context. Truncation is refused." ProteinGLM is now treated like every other
# 1024-context arm on this queue. EXPECTED OUTCOME, declared before the run:
# 201 assays scored over 163 families and 16 assays skipped on the context
# reason, matching ProGen2-small, ZymCTRL and RITA-xl -- all of which take the
# same 16-assay exclusion. 201 is what ProGen2-small and RITA-xl already record
# on this queue. A different skip count is a finding, not an adjustment.
# The estimation arguments are the failed cell's own, unchanged:
# `--stages score --arms proteinglm-7b-clm --dtype float32 --variants 1000
# --seed 20260807 --batch-size 16`, and the same `--proteingym-dir`. float32 is
# this arm's declared serving precision, not a choice made here.
# Two cells from the previous freeze are NOT part of this manifest and are not
# re-run: pgym_zymctrl exited 0 with 0 of 217 assays scored (a corpus-driven
# refusal, not a defect), and the 13 pure-text text-AA columns remain out of
# scope by user decision.
# One cell on gpu 1, dispatched CONCURRENTLY with the re-run queue that is
# already running on gpu 0 of the same allocation. That is deliberate and it is
# read off h200_campaign_queue.sh's own behaviour rather than assumed:
#   * the mutual-exclusion lock is `${STATUS}.lock`, and STATUS defaults to
#     `<project>/logs/external_baseline/<campaign>.status.tsv` with `<campaign>`
#     taken from the manifest's basename -- so two different campaigns hold two
#     different locks and cannot refuse or disturb each other;
#   * GPU admission is per card: `gpu_is_busy <index>` reads that card's own
#     `memory.used` from nvidia-smi and compares it with BUSY_MIB (1000 MiB). A
#     cell is refused only if ITS card is busy, so the running campaign's ~25 GB
#     on cuda:0 cannot block a cell on cuda:1, and this cell cannot disturb it;
#   * status file, queue log and host resource snapshots are all named after the
#     campaign, so the two runners share no mutable file.
# The alternative -- waiting for the other campaign to reach a terminal state --
# would leave three of four cards idle for about an hour for no safety gained.
# The 1-GPU allocation running Galactica-30B fullscore is a different pod and is
# untouched either way.
# stage_score reads wildtypes.json from its own --out, which this runner
# injects, so the frozen catalogue is staged into the cell directory before
# dispatch and is not the cell's expect basename.
